events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Edge Slightly Lower
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Thursday unexpectedly showing a slight dip in first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits in the week ended October 24th. The report said initial jobless claims edged down to 194,000, a decrease of 1,000 from the previous week's revised level of 195,000. Economists had expected jobless claims to rise to rise to 199,000.

events.title: Bay Street Looks Headed For Weak Start
events.description: Lower Canadian and U.S. futures and weak commodity prices point to a weak open on Bay Street Thursday morning. The U.S. PCE data, and a slew of earnings announcements from U.S. and Canadian companies are likely to make a notable impact on price movements in the market.

events.title: U.S. PCE Price Index Increases In Line With Estimates In September
events.description: A closely watched report released by the Commerce Department on Thursday showed consumer prices in the U.S. increased in line with economist estimates in the month of September.

events.title: U.S. GDP Surges More Than Expected In Q3
events.description: Economic growth in the U.S. exceeded economist estimates in the third quarter of 2026, according to a report released by the Commerce Department on Thursday.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Edge Down To 194,000
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Thursday unexpectedly showing a slight dip in first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits in the week ended October 24th.

events.title: Eurozone Economic Sentiment Weakens To 4-Month Low
events.description: Eurozone economic sentiment deteriorated to a four-month low in October as sentiment weakened across most sectors, monthly survey data from the European Commission revealed Thursday. The economic confidence index dropped to 96.9 in October from revised 97.5 in the previous month.

events.title: FTSE 100 Modestly Higher As Investors Focus On Earnings
events.description: The U.K. stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 gained modest ground in positive territory Thursday morning, with investors largely reacting to corporate earnings announcements, while continuing to closely track geopolitical developments.

events.title: Indian Shares Rally On US-Iran Diplomacy Hopes
events.description: Indian shares rallied on Thursday after the U.S. Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, as widely expected, and oil prices eased following fresh diplomatic efforts to end the war in the Middle East.

events.title: CAC 40 Hits 2-week High; Renault Rallies On Strong Earnings
events.description: France's CAC 40 equity benchmark climbed to a two-week high Thursday as investors digested corporate earnings and awaited the European Central Bank's monetary policy announcement. The index advanced 76.14 points or 0.97% to 7,963.10.

events.title: Gold Slips As Investors Seek Clarity On US Rate Outlook
events.description: Gold prices fell toward $4,000 an ounce on Thursday after the U.S. Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, as widely expected, but offered little clarity on its next move.

events.title: Volkswagen Q3 Loss Widens Sharply On Charge, Weak Volume; Confirms FY26 View
events.description: German automotive major Volkswagen AG reported Thursday sharply wider net loss in its third quarter on an impairment charge related to Porsche AG and weak revenues amid lower production and sales volume. Further, the firm maintained its recently lowered fiscal 2026 outlook. On the XETRA in Germany, Volkswagen shares were losing around 1.08 percent

events.title: German DAX Climbs 1.13% Ahead Of ECB Decision
events.description: German stocks extended gains to a fourth consecutive session Thursday, with the DAX rising 289.72 points to 25,993.74 as investors tracked earnings and awaited the European Central Bank's monetary policy announcement and U.S. PCE inflation data.

events.title: Oil Edges Lower On US-Iran Diplomacy Hopes
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Thursday after surging to a six-month high in the previous session following reports of Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabi's biggest oil refinery and a decline in U.S. crude inventories.
